messages:
sam: Heads up — customer reported our support API call turned into an incident (PagerDuty trigger) instead of a normal ticket. They called `POST /v1/support/tickets` but PD was paged.

alex: Yikes. Do we have the raw payload + headers?

sam: Pasting redacted payload they sent (customer id and token removed):
```
{
  \"subject\": \"Billing spike after plan change\",
  \"description\": \"Customer saw unexpected 5xx + charge attempt, asked for review\",
  \"priority\": \"P1\",
  \"source\": \"api\",
  \"meta\": { \"account_age_days\": 420 }
}
```

alex: That `priority: \"P1\"` is likely the culprit — our tool selector has two handlers: `log_ticket` (expects priority enum low/med/high) and `trigger_incident` (matches on substring P1/P0). Fuzzy match bumped it to incident.

priya: Confirmed in router logs for that request id (redacted): `chosen_tool=trigger_incident (score=0.82)`, `log_ticket(score=0.79)`. Scores were very close.

chandra: Repro steps I ran locally:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/support/tickets \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"subject\":\"test\",\"description\":\"x\",\"priority\":\"P1\",\"source\":\"api\"}'
```
Result: router invoked `trigger_incident`.

sam: Customer hit PagerDuty and woke on-call. They want a root cause and mitigation.

alex: Short term mitigation: change incident tool match to require `priority` to be specifically `P0` or include `escalate=true` flag. I'll push a hotfix to the router rule set.

priya: Also add a small normalization step: map `P1` -> `high` for legacy customers so they go to `log_ticket`. That avoids breaking other integrations.

chandra: Long term: update signature matcher to prefer schema-constrained matches. `log_ticket` signature already defines `priority: enum[low,medium,high]` so router should prefer that if payload validates. We need to enforce schema validation as a higher-priority signal.

sam: Customer-facing workaround suggested: call with `priority: \"high\"` or include `intent: \"ticket\"`. I told CS to send that while we patch.

ops-bot: Deploy queued by alex: router/rules hotfix -> staging (build #4721).

alex: Hotfix notes: 1) tighten incident fuzzy rule to reject `P1`/`P2` unless `escalate` present, 2) add unit test cases covering `P0,P1,P2,high`. Pushed PR + request for review.

priya: I'll add a regression test to the e2e harness that sends `priority: "P1"` and expects `log_ticket`.

chandra: Follow-ups: update docs for legacy priority tokens, add telemetry to count how many requests with `P1` mapping landed in incident tool over last 7d. Can someone run query?

sam: I'll run the query and paste numbers in this thread. For CS, I've sent the workaround to the customer and escalated to SE for a one-off apology message.

alex: ETA for prod hotfix after review: ~2 hours. If anything changes I'll post here. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks — much appreciated.

(prioritized action items)
- alex: push hotfix + tests -> PR
- priya: add e2e regression test
- chandra: schema-priority improvement design doc
- sam: notify customer + run telemetry

last: alex: PR merged, hotfix deployed to prod (2439994567). Monitoring for any false-negatives for next 24h.
